senses.gloss: ʿakkum, abbrev. for עבודת כוכבים ומזלות idolatry; for עובד כוכבים ומזלות, or עוֹבֶדֶת, or עוֹבְדֵי idolater, idolatress, idolaters (interchanging in editions respectively with ע״ז, ע״עז, גוי, נכרי &c.) Zeb. 40ᵇ שעירי ע׳ goats offered to atone for idolatry.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 59a">Snh. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>אפי׳ ע׳ עוסק בתורה וכ׳</he> even an idolater (gentile) studying the Law is the equal of the high priest; (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 3a">Ab. Zar. 3ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="N00847"><he>נכרי</he></cite>); <cite ref="Bava Kamma 38a">B. Kam. 38ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
